brief.headline: Premium formats leader under CTV and retail-media budget pressure.
brief.decision: Prioritize CTV format parity and a measurable identity/partnership story before mid-market buyers consolidate on StackAdapt or Trade Desk bundles.

threats.title: StackAdapt CTV hub encroachment
threats.summary: Mid-market buyers can buy CTV + creative + quality in one self-serve login — same RFP lane as Kargo formats.

threats.title: Retail media budget pull
threats.summary: Amazon Ads and Criteo Commerce Max redirect performance dollars away from standalone format vendors.

threats.title: Identity expectations rising
threats.summary: Trade Desk UID2 sets buyer expectation that scale platforms ship identity — Kargo has no named identity SKU.

threats.title: Privacy and measurement tightening
threats.summary: Cookie deprecation and state privacy laws increase demand for verified attention metrics — peers investing in data clouds.

leadership.name: VP Product, CTV
leadership.summary: Senior product hire signals CTV roadmap acceleration — public LinkedIn listing.

leadership.name: Chief Revenue Officer
leadership.summary: StackAdapt scaling enterprise sales — watch for mid-market CTV RFP competition.

leadership.name: Head of Identity Partnerships
leadership.summary: UID2 publisher recruitment accelerating — raises identity bar for format vendors.

brief.headline: Identity + AI platform moat — defend against retail media budget shift.
brief.decision: Double down on Kokai and UID2 narrative in agency RFPs; partner for high-impact formats rather than building creative SKUs.

threats.title: Retail media share of wallet
threats.summary: Amazon and Criteo capture commerce-intent budgets that historically funded open-web programmatic.

threats.title: Mid-market self-serve platforms
threats.summary: StackAdapt wins SMB/mid-market with bundled CTV + creative where TTD requires specialist ops.

threats.title: Identity regulation uncertainty
threats.summary: UID2 adoption depends on publisher opt-in trends and regulatory scrutiny of alternative IDs.

leadership.name: Director, Retail Media
leadership.summary: Amazon expanding off-Amazon retail media sales — direct TTD budget overlap.

leadership.name: Senior Director, Kokai
leadership.summary: AI bidding team expansion — Kokai remains the flagship enterprise narrative.

brief.headline: Mid-market platform gaining share — CTV + creative bundle is the wedge.
brief.decision: Accelerate CTV hub GTM in regions where Kargo shows search spikes; maintain IVT Shield as the quality differentiator.

threats.title: Trade Desk enterprise down-market
threats.summary: Kokai narrative and OpenPath retail pipes pressure mid-market accounts evaluating StackAdapt.

threats.title: Format specialists on CTV
threats.summary: Kargo and Magnite partner narratives can displace platform story when buyers want named units.

threats.title: Third-party identity dependency
threats.summary: No owned identity stack while Trade Desk sets the cookieless standard.

leadership.name: Head of CTV
leadership.summary: CTV hub GTM hire — direct competitive signal vs Kargo format RFPs.

leadership.name: VP Publisher Solutions
leadership.summary: Magnite strengthening publisher-facing CTV sales — potential partner or rival.

brief.headline: Sell-side CTV scale leader — partner opportunity more than direct overlap.
brief.decision: Pursue publisher pipe partnerships for CTV inventory access; avoid competing on brand-facing format RFPs.

threats.title: Buy-side platform disintermediation
threats.summary: Trade Desk and Amazon build direct publisher paths that bypass SSP pipes.

threats.title: CTV consolidation
threats.summary: Streaming ad tech M&A could compress SSP margins and partner options.

leadership.name: SVP Streaming Partnerships
leadership.summary: Streaming publisher recruitment — expands CTV supply side of the market.

brief.headline: Retail media gravity well — pulls performance budgets from open-web formats.
brief.decision: Track AMC and off-Amazon DSP bundling as a budget-risk signal; position where shopping data cannot compete.

threats.title: Antitrust and retail media scrutiny
threats.summary: Regulatory attention on Amazon's ad business could affect AMC and DSP bundling.

threats.title: Criteo Commerce Max off-site
threats.summary: Non-Amazon retailers activate audiences off-site — direct counter to Amazon DSP exclusivity.

leadership.name: Principal PM, AMC
leadership.summary: Marketing Cloud expansion — clean-room analytics pulling agency data budgets.

leadership.name: Global Head, Commerce Max
leadership.summary: Criteo scaling off-site retail media — counter-move to Amazon DSP.

brief.headline: Commerce media challenger bundling off-site retail — watch mid-market consolidation.
brief.decision: Monitor Commerce Max agency wins; differentiate on premium publisher relationships Kargo already holds.

threats.title: Amazon retail media scale
threats.summary: Amazon Ads shopping data and Prime Video inventory outpace Criteo's retailer network breadth.

threats.title: Mid-market platform bundling
threats.summary: Buyers consolidate vendors — Commerce Max + display bundles reduce standalone format spend.
